subject: Discretionary signing incentive approval request — Staff Infra candidate (Elena Rossi)
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-08T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Discretionary signing incentive request for Elena Rossi (Staff Infra)

Hi Laura / Marcus —

Quick context: Elena Rossi (candidate) received a competing counteroffer from her current employer this morning after verbal acceptance. Her base and equity were negotiated at the top of the Staff Infra comp band but the hiring manager recommends a one-time discretionary signing incentive to keep the timeline intact and avoid losing momentum.

Request (out-of-band exception):
- One-time signing incentive: $30,000 cash
- Equity refresh: additional 0.25% (mini-refresh on top of the original grant)

Rationale:
- Candidate has a retention clause triggering a higher counteroffer unless we act today.
- Hiring manager (Marcus) verifies this role is mission-critical for Q2 infra migrations and onboarding delay risks product timelines.
- Total comp impact is small relative to projected team revenue impact from delayed delivery.

Attachments: resume, comp band comparison, current offer term sheet (draft).

Ask: Can you approve this discretionary package so I can push the final DocuSign offer by EOD today? If you prefer, we can structure cash as $25k upfront + $5k milestone at 6 months.

Thanks — I know this is a little out of band; happy to jump on a quick call.

— Ava

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-08T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Discretionary signing incentive request for Elena Rossi (Staff Infra)

Ava —

Thanks for the summary. I am provisionally supportive of a discretionary signing incentive given the retention risk and role impact, but I need a short justification memo (2–3 bullets) and total 12‑month comp run rate impact for finance. Also want to flag that any equity refresh must be reviewed by comp to ensure it doesn't create precedent for other staff hires in the same band.

If you can send the updated term sheet (with proposed cash split if you prefer the milestone structure) I will sign off here and route to CFO for final spend approval. Please note: approval by 5pm PT today would be ideal.

— Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, People Operations

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-08T11:17:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Discretionary signing incentive request for Elena Rossi (Staff Infra)

Appreciate the fast turnaround. A couple of data points from my side:
- Role impact: Elena will lead the infra orchestration piece needed for the January migration. Delay likely adds ~3 weeks to rollout across two product teams.
- Budget: team has ~75% of hiring buffer remaining but not in the exact GL code for discretionary payments — will need Neha to confirm GL.

I prefer the split: $25k now + $5k at 6 months contingent on retention. For the equity refresh, can we cap to 0.2% instead of 0.25% to mitigate comp-band precedent? If comp pushes back, we accept 0.25 only if we formalize a one-off clause saying this refresh is not precedent-setting.

If Laura is good, I will coordinate with Neha on GL and with finance for accounting treatment.

— Marcus
Marcus Lin
Head of Infrastructure

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-09T15:04:00-08:00
Subject: Finalized terms and DocuSign link — Elena Rossi (Staff Infra)

Laura / Marcus —

Thanks for the quick replies. Per Marcus' suggestion I updated the structure and term sheet:
- Cash: $25,000 payable at signing + $5,000 retention payment after 6 months
- Equity: 0.20% refresh with explicit non-precedent clause included in the letter

Attached: offer_term_sheet_v2.pdf (includes clause), comp_band_comparison.xlsx, resume.

DocuSign: https://na.docusign.net/elo/doc/12345 (offer ready for Elena)

Laura — you indicated provisional approval; please confirm so I can send to DocuSign and loop finance.

Neha — can you confirm GL code and whether we need PO or specific finance workflow for the $30k discretionary spend? If you can route to finance and cc me, I will hold the DocuSign send until we have the GL.

If all green, I will request signature from Elena and update the ATS.

Thanks all — moving quickly here to avoid losing the candidate.

— Ava
